title: English Conversation 18:  A New Hairstyle
content: 1. a new look: a new style - I like your new look. - I think I need a new look. 2. to be old-fashioned: a style, method, or thing that is no longer cool, in fashion, or widely used - Our logo is kind of old-fashioned. I think we need to design a new logo. - He likes to wear old-fashioned clothes. 3. to be hard to maintain something: to not be easy to keep in good condition - It is hard to maintain a clean house when you have 3 small children. - It is hard to maintain this kind of car.
